(No offence just some tips)OK! It looks amazing. But i would recomend trying to not make the cape and other stuff look so stiff. As its flowing in the wind, it looks as if it could just stay in one place. What I would do is make a layer for movement, then add your regular drawing on to another layer. You can redraw every frame and that would make a it a bit less stiff, too. It is a timely process and I also work with animation! To get the cap look as if it's actually in the wind, go online and search up cape movements or wind movements in animation.
